## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The header check is correct and `test_rejects_unsupported_header_with_complete_report` covers it, so only an optional correction was found: `test_rejects_legacy_header` never reaches the version check.

## Changes
`parse_report` now accepts only the exact header `REPORT v1` instead of any header starting with `REPORT `. The pull request also adds two tests that check unsupported headers are rejected.

## Suggestions
- tests/test_report.py:11 — tests — Make the legacy-header test reach the version check — Line 11 builds `"REPORT v1\nversion=v0"`. It replaces the body's `v1` and leaves the header as `REPORT v1`. The input has no `END` line, so `parse_report` returns `None` at `app/report.py:3` before the header check on line 5 runs. Line 9 says it changes "the fixture's version to v0", but the header never changes. — This test still passes if the version check is removed, so it gives no regression protection beyond the adjacent test. — Fix: Use a complete report with a `REPORT v0` header, or delete the test because `test_rejects_unsupported_header_with_complete_report` already covers this case.
